name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: A Central Sector Scheme to provide income support to all landholding farmer families across India to help them meet agricultural and domestic needs.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefits: Financial benefit of Rs. 6,000 per year payable in three equal instalments of Rs. 2,000 every four months, credited directly into Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts through DBT.

source_evidence.statement: Administered by the Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

source_evidence.statement: Central sector scheme covering all agricultural landholding families across India.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

source_evidence.statement: All landholding farmer families having cultivable landholding in their names.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

source_evidence.statement: Rs. 6,000 per year transferred in three equal instalments of Rs. 2,000 via DBT into Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

source_evidence.statement: Official portal and online self-registration for farmers hosted on pmkisan.gov.in.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

source_evidence.statement: 24th installment released on 30 October 2026 from Banaskantha, Gujarat, disbursing over Rs. 18,690 crore to more than 9.34 crore farmer families.

eligibility_criteria.limitations: Core statutory eligibility conditions verified from Operational Guidelines; detailed exclusion categories (e.g. constitutional posts, institutional landholders) defined per guidelines.

required_documents.title: Aadhaar Card
required_documents.description: UIDAI Aadhaar card for citizen identity and biometric e-KYC verification.
required_documents.guidance: Link Aadhaar with active bank account and verify mobile number for OTP.

required_documents.title: Land Ownership Records (Khatauni/Patta)
required_documents.description: Official land record extract demonstrating cultivable land title in beneficiary name.
required_documents.guidance: Obtain certified copy from state revenue Bhulekh portal or local Tehsildar.

required_documents.title: Bank Passbook or Account Details
required_documents.description: Copy of bank passbook or cancelled cheque showing IFSC and NPCI-mapped account.
required_documents.guidance: Ensure account is Aadhaar-seeded via NPCI mapper for Direct Benefit Transfer.
